<p>本文分享自天翼云开发者社区《<a href="https://www.ctyun.cn/developer/article/428339321733189" rel="noopener nofollow">Kafka配置SASL_SSL认证传输加密</a>》，作者：王****帅</p>
<h1>一、SSL证书配置</h1>
<h4>1、生成证书</h4>
<p>&nbsp; &nbsp; 如我输入命令如下：依次是 密码—重输密码—名与姓—组织单位—组织名—城市—省份—国家两位代码—密码—重输密码，后面告警不用管，此步骤要注意的是，名与姓这一项必须输入域名，如 “localhost”,切记不可以随意写，我曾尝试使用其他字符串，在后面客户端生成证书认证的时候一直有问题。</p>
<pre class="language-bash"><code class="language-bash">keytool <span class="token parameter variable">-keystore server.keystore.jks <span class="token parameter variable">-alias localhost <span class="token parameter variable">-validity <span class="token number">3650 <span class="token parameter variable">-genkey
Enter keystore password:
Re-enter new password:
What is your first and last name?
<span class="token punctuation">[Unknown<span class="token punctuation">]:  localhost
What is the name of your organizational unit?
<span class="token punctuation">[Unknown<span class="token punctuation">]:  CH-kafka
What is the name of your organization?
<span class="token punctuation">[Unknown<span class="token punctuation">]:  kafkadev
What is the name of your City or Locality?
<span class="token punctuation">[Unknown<span class="token punctuation">]:  shanghai
What is the name of your State or Province?
<span class="token punctuation">[Unknown<span class="token punctuation">]:  shanghai
What is the two-letter country code <span class="token keyword">for this unit?
<span class="token punctuation">[Unknown<span class="token punctuation">]:  CH
Is <span class="token assign-left variable">CN<span class="token operator">=localhost, <span class="token assign-left variable">OU<span class="token operator">=CH-kafka, <span class="token assign-left variable">O<span class="token operator">=kafkadev, <span class="token assign-left variable">L<span class="token operator">=shanghai, <span class="token assign-left variable">ST<span class="token operator">=shanghai, <span class="token assign-left variable">C<span class="token operator">=CH correct?
<span class="token punctuation">[no<span class="token punctuation">]:  <span class="token function">yes
Enter key password <span class="token keyword">for <span class="token operator">&lt;localhost<span class="token operator">&gt;
	<span class="token punctuation">(RETURN <span class="token keyword">if same as keystore password<span class="token punctuation">):  
Re-enter new password: 
Warning:
The JKS keystore uses a proprietary format. It is recommended to migrate to PKCS12 <span class="token function">which is an industry standard <span class="token function">format using <span class="token string">"keytool -importkeystore -srckeystore server.keystore.jks -destkeystore server.keystore.jks -deststoretype pkcs12"<span class="token builtin class-name">.
</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
<p>完成上面步骤，可使用命令 keytool -list -v -keystore server.keystore.jks 来验证生成证书的内容</p>
<h4>2、生成CA</h4>
<p>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;通过第一步，集群中的每台机器都生成一对公私钥，和一个证书来识别机器。但是，证书是未签名的，这意味着攻击者可以创建一个这样的证书来伪装成任何机器。</p>
<p>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;因此，通过对集群中的每台机器进行签名来防止伪造的证书。证书颁发机构（CA）负责签名证书。CA的工作机制像一个颁发护照的政府。政府印章（标志）每本护照，这样护照很难伪造。其他政府核实护照的印章，以确保护照是真实的。同样，CA签名的证书和加密保证签名证书很难伪造。因此，只要CA是一个真正和值得信赖的权威，client就能有较高的保障连接的是真正的机器。如下，生成的CA是一个简单的公私钥对和证书，用于签名其他的证书，下面为输入命令，依次提示输入为 密码—重输密码—国家两位代码—省份—城市—名与姓—组织名—组织单位—名与姓(域名)—邮箱 ，此输入步骤与上面生成证书世输入步骤相反，输入值要与第一步一致，邮箱可不输入<br><br></p>
<pre class="language-bash"><code class="language-bash">openssl req <span class="token parameter variable">-new <span class="token parameter variable">-x509 <span class="token parameter variable">-keyout ca-key <span class="token parameter variable">-out ca-cert <span class="token parameter variable">-days <span class="token number">3650 Generating a <span class="token number">2048 bit RSA private key <span class="token punctuation">..<span class="token punctuation">..<span class="token punctuation">..<span class="token punctuation">..<span class="token punctuation">..<span class="token punctuation">..<span class="token punctuation">..<span class="token punctuation">..<span class="token punctuation">..<span class="token punctuation">..<span class="token punctuation">..<span class="token punctuation">..<span class="token punctuation">..<span class="token punctuation">..<span class="token punctuation">..<span class="token punctuation">..<span class="token punctuation">..<span class="token punctuation">..<span class="token punctuation">..<span class="token punctuation">..<span class="token punctuation">..<span class="token punctuation">..<span class="token punctuation">..<span class="token punctuation">..<span class="token punctuation">..<span class="token punctuation">..<span class="token punctuation">..<span class="token punctuation">..<span class="token punctuation">..<span class="token punctuation">..<span class="token punctuation">..<span class="token punctuation">..<span class="token punctuation">..<span class="token punctuation">..<span class="token punctuation">..<span class="token punctuation">...+++ <span class="token punctuation">..<span class="token punctuation">..<span class="token punctuation">..<span class="token punctuation">..<span class="token punctuation">..<span class="token punctuation">..<span class="token punctuation">..<span class="token punctuation">..<span class="token punctuation">..+++ writing new private key to <span class="token string">'ca-key' Enter PEM pass phrase: Verifying - Enter PEM pass phrase: ----- You are about to be asked to enter information that will be incorporated into your certificate request. What you are about to enter is what is called a Distinguished Name or a DN. There are quite a few fields but you can leave some blank For some fields there will be a default value, If you enter <span class="token string">'.', the field will be left blank. ----- Country Name <span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token number">2 letter code<span class="token punctuation">) <span class="token punctuation">[XX<span class="token punctuation">]:CH State or Province Name <span class="token punctuation">(full name<span class="token punctuation">) <span class="token punctuation">[<span class="token punctuation">]:shanghai Locality Name <span class="token punctuation">(eg, city<span class="token punctuation">) <span class="token punctuation">[Default City<span class="token punctuation">]:shanghai Organization Name <span class="token punctuation">(eg, company<span class="token punctuation">) <span class="token punctuation">[Default Company Ltd<span class="token punctuation">]:kafkadev Organizational Unit Name <span class="token punctuation">(eg, section<span class="token punctuation">) <span class="token punctuation">[<span class="token punctuation">]:CH-kafka Common Name <span class="token punctuation">(eg, your name or your server<span class="token string">'s hostname) []:localhost Email Address []: 

将生成的CA添加到**clients' truststore（客户的信任库）**，以便client可以信任这个CA:

keytool <span class="token parameter variable">-keystore server.truststore.jks <span class="token parameter variable">-alias CARoot <span class="token parameter variable">-import <span class="token parameter variable">-file ca-cert keytool <span class="token parameter variable">-keystore client.truststore.jks <span class="token parameter variable">-alias CARoot <span class="token parameter variable">-import <span class="token parameter variable">-file ca-cert 
</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
<h4><strong>3、签名证书</strong></h4>
<p>用<strong>步骤2</strong>生成的CA来签名所有<strong>步骤1</strong>生成的证书，首先，你需要从密钥仓库导出证书：</p>
<pre class="language-bash"><code class="language-bash">keytool <span class="token parameter variable">-keystore server.keystore.jks <span class="token parameter variable">-alias localhost <span class="token parameter variable">-certreq <span class="token parameter variable">-file cert-file </span></span></span></span></code></pre>
<p>然后用CA签名：{validity}，{ca-password} 两个为参数，</p>
<pre class="language-bash"><code class="language-bash">openssl x509 <span class="token parameter variable">-req <span class="token parameter variable">-CA ca-cert <span class="token parameter variable">-CAkey ca-key <span class="token parameter variable">-in cert-file <span class="token parameter variable">-out cert-signed <span class="token parameter variable">-days <span class="token punctuation">{validity<span class="token punctuation">} <span class="token parameter variable">-CAcreateserial <span class="token parameter variable">-passin pass:<span class="token punctuation">{ca-password<span class="token punctuation">}</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
<p>最后,你需要导入CA的证书和已签名的证书到密钥仓库:</p>
<pre class="language-bash"><code class="language-bash">keytool <span class="token parameter variable">-keystore server.keystore.jks <span class="token parameter variable">-alias CARoot <span class="token parameter variable">-import <span class="token parameter variable">-file ca-cert keytool <span class="token parameter variable">-keystore server.keystore.jks <span class="token parameter variable">-alias localhost <span class="token parameter variable">-import <span class="token parameter variable">-file cert-signed 
</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
<p>上文中的各参数解释如下：</p>
<p>keystore: 密钥仓库的位置</p>
<p>ca-cert: CA的证书</p>
<p>ca-key: CA的私钥</p>
<p>ca-password: CA的密码</p>
<p>cert-file: 出口，服务器的未签名证书</p>
<p>cert-signed: 已签名的服务器证书</p>
<p>上面步骤所有执行脚本如下：注意密码修改为自己的密码,以防混淆，所有步骤密码最好设为同一个</p>
<pre class="language-bash"><code class="language-bash"><span class="token shebang important">#!/bin/bash
<span class="token comment">#Step 1
keytool <span class="token parameter variable">-keystore server.keystore.jks <span class="token parameter variable">-alias localhost <span class="token parameter variable">-validity <span class="token number">3650 <span class="token parameter variable">-keyalg RSA <span class="token parameter variable">-genkey
<span class="token comment">#Step 2
openssl req <span class="token parameter variable">-new <span class="token parameter variable">-x509 <span class="token parameter variable">-keyout ca-key <span class="token parameter variable">-out ca-cert <span class="token parameter variable">-days <span class="token number">3650
keytool <span class="token parameter variable">-keystore server.truststore.jks <span class="token parameter variable">-alias CARoot <span class="token parameter variable">-import <span class="token parameter variable">-file ca-cert
keytool <span class="token parameter variable">-keystore client.truststore.jks <span class="token parameter variable">-alias CARoot <span class="token parameter variable">-import <span class="token parameter variable">-file ca-cert
<span class="token comment">#Step 3
keytool <span class="token parameter variable">-keystore server.keystore.jks <span class="token parameter variable">-alias localhost <span class="token parameter variable">-certreq <span class="token parameter variable">-file cert-file
openssl x509 <span class="token parameter variable">-req <span class="token parameter variable">-CA ca-cert <span class="token parameter variable">-CAkey ca-key <span class="token parameter variable">-in cert-file <span class="token parameter variable">-out cert-signed <span class="token parameter variable">-days <span class="token number">3650 <span class="token parameter variable">-CAcreateserial <span class="token parameter variable">-passin pass:123456
keytool <span class="token parameter variable">-keystore server.keystore.jks <span class="token parameter variable">-alias CARoot <span class="token parameter variable">-import <span class="token parameter variable">-file ca-cert
keytool <span class="token parameter variable">-keystore server.keystore.jks <span class="token parameter variable">-alias localhost <span class="token parameter variable">-import <span class="token parameter variable">-file cert-signed
<span class="token comment">#Step 4
keytool <span class="token parameter variable">-keystore client.keystore.jks <span class="token parameter variable">-alias localhost <span class="token parameter variable">-validity <span class="token number">3650 <span class="token parameter variable">-keyalg RSA <span class="token parameter variable">-genkey</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
<h1>二、配置zookeeper的安全认证</h1>
<h4>1、在zookeeper的conf文件夹下创建jaas.conf安全配置文件</h4>
<p>此文件中定义了两个用户 admin以及kafka 等于号后面是用户对应的密码<br>此文件定义的是连接zookeeper服务器的用户 JAAS配置节点默认为Server(节点名不可修改，修改后会报错)</p>
<pre class="language-bash"><code class="language-bash">Server <span class="token punctuation">{
  org.apache.zookeeper.server.auth.DigestLoginModule required
  <span class="token assign-left variable">user_admin<span class="token operator">=<span class="token string">"!234Qwer"
  <span class="token assign-left variable">user_kafka<span class="token operator">=<span class="token string">"clearwater001"<span class="token punctuation">;
<span class="token punctuation">}<span class="token punctuation">;
</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
<h4><strong>2、在zookeeper的配置文件zoo.cfg中添加认证配置源文件如下</strong></h4>
<pre class="language-bash"><code class="language-bash"><span class="token assign-left variable">tickTime<span class="token operator">=<span class="token number">2000
<span class="token assign-left variable">initLimit<span class="token operator">=<span class="token number">10
<span class="token assign-left variable">syncLimit<span class="token operator">=<span class="token number">5
<span class="token assign-left variable">dataDir<span class="token operator">=/usr/local/zookeeper/apache-zookeeper-3.5.9-bin/data
<span class="token assign-left variable">dataLogDir<span class="token operator">=/usr/local/zookeeper/apache-zookeeper-3.5.9-bin/logs
<span class="token assign-left variable">clientPort<span class="token operator">=<span class="token number">2181
<span class="token comment">#sasl认证
<span class="token assign-left variable">authProvider.1<span class="token operator">=org.apache.zookeeper.server.auth.SASLAuthenticationProvider
<span class="token assign-left variable">requireClientAuthScheme<span class="token operator">=sasl
<span class="token assign-left variable">jaasLoginRenew<span class="token operator">=<span class="token number">3600000
</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
<h4><strong>3、在zkEnv.sh启动环境脚本中添加jvm参数，将jaas的配置文件位置作为JVM参数传递给每个客户端的JVM</strong></h4>
<pre class="language-bash"><code class="language-bash">  <span class="token assign-left variable">LIBPATH<span class="token operator">=<span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token string">"<span class="token variable">${ZOOKEEPER_PREFIX}"/share/zookeeper/*.jar<span class="token punctuation">)
<span class="token keyword">else
  <span class="token comment">#release tarball format

    <span class="token assign-left variable">CLASSPATH<span class="token operator">=<span class="token string">"<span class="token variable">$i:<span class="token variable">$CLASSPATH"
  <span class="token keyword">done
  <span class="token assign-left variable">LIBPATH<span class="token operator">=<span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token string">"<span class="token variable">${ZOOBINDIR}"/<span class="token punctuation">../lib/*.jar<span class="token punctuation">)

<span class="token keyword">do
    <span class="token assign-left variable">CLASSPATH<span class="token operator">=<span class="token string">"<span class="token variable">$i:<span class="token variable">$CLASSPATH"
<span class="token keyword">done

<span class="token keyword">do
   <span class="token assign-left variable">CLASSPATH<span class="token operator">=<span class="token string">"<span class="token variable">$d:<span class="token variable">$CLASSPATH"
<span class="token keyword">done

<span class="token keyword">case <span class="token string">"<span class="token variable"><span class="token variable">`<span class="token function">uname<span class="token variable">`" <span class="token keyword">in

    *<span class="token punctuation">) <span class="token assign-left variable">cygwin<span class="token operator">=false <span class="token punctuation">;<span class="token punctuation">;

    <span class="token assign-left variable">CLASSPATH<span class="token operator">=<span class="token variable"><span class="token variable">`cygpath <span class="token parameter variable">-wp <span class="token string">"<span class="token variable">$CLASSPATH"<span class="token variable">`

<span class="token comment">#echo "CLASSPATH=$CLASSPATH"

<h1>三、配置kafka的安全认证</h1>
<h4><br>1、在kafka的conf目录下创建jaas.conf认证文件</h4>
<p>username和password属性 用来定义kafka中各个broker节点之间相互通信的用户<br>user_用来定义连接到kafka中各个broker的用户 这些用户可供生产者以及消费者进行使用<br>两个用户的配置均在JAAS默认配置节点KafkaServer中进行配置<br>broker连接到zookeeper的用户在JAAS默认配置节点Client中进行配置，从上面zookeeper中的jaas文件中选择一个用户进行使用<br><br></p>
<pre class="language-bash"><code class="language-bash">KafkaServer <span class="token punctuation">{
        org.apache.kafka.common.security.plain.PlainLoginModule required
        <span class="token assign-left variable">username<span class="token operator">=<span class="token string">"admin"
        <span class="token assign-left variable">password<span class="token operator">=<span class="token string">"clearwater"
        <span class="token assign-left variable">user_admin<span class="token operator">=<span class="token string">"clearwater"
        <span class="token assign-left variable">user_kafka<span class="token operator">=<span class="token string">"!234Qwer"<span class="token punctuation">;
<span class="token punctuation">}<span class="token punctuation">;
Client <span class="token punctuation">{
  org.apache.kafka.common.security.plain.PlainLoginModule required
    <span class="token assign-left variable">username<span class="token operator">=<span class="token string">"kafka"
    <span class="token assign-left variable">password<span class="token operator">=<span class="token string">"clearwater001"<span class="token punctuation">;
<span class="token punctuation">}<span class="token punctuation">;
</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
<pre class="prettyprint">&nbsp;</pre>
<h4><strong>2、在kafka的conf目录下创建kafka_client_jaas.conf认证文件</strong></h4>
<pre class="language-bash"><code class="language-bash">KafkaClient <span class="token punctuation">{
        org.apache.kafka.common.security.plain.PlainLoginModule required
        <span class="token assign-left variable">username<span class="token operator">=<span class="token string">"kafka"
        <span class="token assign-left variable">password<span class="token operator">=<span class="token string">"!234Qwer"<span class="token punctuation">;
<span class="token punctuation">}<span class="token punctuation">;
</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
<h4><strong>3、在kafka的bin目录下kafka-server-start.sh的启动脚本中配置环境变量，指定jaas.conf文件</strong></h4>
<pre class="language-bash"><code class="language-bash"><span class="token keyword">if <span class="token punctuation">[ <span class="token variable">$# <span class="token parameter variable">-lt <span class="token number">1 <span class="token punctuation">]<span class="token punctuation">;
<span class="token keyword">then
	<span class="token builtin class-name">echo <span class="token string">"USAGE: <span class="token variable">$0 [-daemon] server.properties [--override property=value]*"
	<span class="token builtin class-name">exit <span class="token number">1
<span class="token keyword">fi
<span class="token assign-left variable">base_dir<span class="token operator">=<span class="token variable"><span class="token variable">$(<span class="token function">dirname $0<span class="token variable">)

<span class="token keyword">if <span class="token punctuation">[ <span class="token string">"x<span class="token variable">$KAFKA_LOG4J_OPTS" <span class="token operator">= <span class="token string">"x" <span class="token punctuation">]<span class="token punctuation">; <span class="token keyword">then
    <span class="token builtin class-name">export <span class="token assign-left variable">KAFKA_LOG4J_OPTS<span class="token operator">=<span class="token string">"-Dlog4j.configuration=file:<span class="token variable">$base_dir/../config/log4j.properties"
<span class="token keyword">fi
<span class="token comment">#环境变量
<span class="token keyword">if <span class="token punctuation">[ <span class="token string">"x<span class="token variable">$KAFKA_HEAP_OPTS" <span class="token operator">= <span class="token string">"x" <span class="token punctuation">]<span class="token punctuation">; <span class="token keyword">then
    <span class="token builtin class-name">export <span class="token assign-left variable">KAFKA_HEAP_OPTS<span class="token operator">=<span class="token string">"-Xmx1G -Xms1G  -Djava.security.auth.login.config=/usr/local/kafka_2.12-2.8.0/config/jaas.conf"
<span class="token keyword">fi

<span class="token assign-left variable">EXTRA_ARGS<span class="token operator">=<span class="token variable">${EXTRA_ARGS-'-name kafkaServer -loggc'}

<span class="token assign-left variable">COMMAND<span class="token operator">=<span class="token variable">$1
<span class="token keyword">case <span class="token variable">$COMMAND <span class="token keyword">in
  -daemon<span class="token punctuation">)
    <span class="token assign-left variable">EXTRA_ARGS<span class="token operator">=<span class="token string">"-daemon "<span class="token variable">$EXTRA_ARGS
    <span class="token builtin class-name">shift
    <span class="token punctuation">;<span class="token punctuation">;
  *<span class="token punctuation">)
    <span class="token punctuation">;<span class="token punctuation">;
<span class="token keyword">esac

<span class="token builtin class-name">exec <span class="token variable">$base_dir/kafka-run-class.sh <span class="token variable">$EXTRA_ARGS kafka.Kafka <span class="token string">"<span class="token variable">$@"
</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
<h4><strong>4、在kafka的bin目录下kafka-console-producer.sh的启动脚本中配置环境变量，指定jaas.conf文件</strong></h4>
<pre class="language-bash"><code class="language-bash"><span class="token keyword">if <span class="token punctuation">[ <span class="token string">"x<span class="token variable">$KAFKA_HEAP_OPTS" <span class="token operator">= <span class="token string">"x" <span class="token punctuation">]<span class="token punctuation">; <span class="token keyword">then
    <span class="token builtin class-name">export <span class="token assign-left variable">KAFKA_HEAP_OPTS<span class="token operator">=<span class="token string">"-Xmx512M -Djava.security.auth.login.config=/usr/local/kafka_2.12-2.8.0/config/kafka_client_jaas.conf"
<span class="token keyword">fi
<span class="token builtin class-name">exec <span class="token variable"><span class="token variable">$(<span class="token function">dirname $0<span class="token variable">)/kafka-run-class.sh kafka.tools.ConsoleProducer <span class="token string">"<span class="token variable">$@"

</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
<h4><strong>5、在kafka的bin目录下kafka-server-start.sh的启动脚本中配置环境变量，指定jaas.conf文件</strong></h4>
<pre class="language-bash"><code class="language-bash"><span class="token keyword">if <span class="token punctuation">[ <span class="token string">"x<span class="token variable">$KAFKA_HEAP_OPTS" <span class="token operator">= <span class="token string">"x" <span class="token punctuation">]<span class="token punctuation">; <span class="token keyword">then
    <span class="token builtin class-name">export <span class="token assign-left variable">KAFKA_HEAP_OPTS<span class="token operator">=<span class="token string">"-Xmx512M -Djava.security.auth.login.config=/usr/local/kafka_2.12-2.8.0/config/kafka_client_jaas.conf"
<span class="token keyword">fi

<span class="token builtin class-name">exec <span class="token variable"><span class="token variable">$(<span class="token function">dirname $0<span class="token variable">)/kafka-run-class.sh kafka.tools.ConsoleConsumer <span class="token string">"<span class="token variable">$@"
</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
<h4><strong>6、在kafka的bin目录下创建client-ssl.properties认证文件（执行生产者和消费者命令时指定）</strong></h4>
<pre class="language-bash"><code class="language-bash"><span class="token assign-left variable">security.protocol<span class="token operator">=SASL_SSL
<span class="token assign-left variable">ssl.endpoint.identification.algorithm<span class="token operator">=
<span class="token assign-left variable">sasl.mechanism<span class="token operator">=PLAIN
<span class="token assign-left variable">group.id<span class="token operator">=test
<span class="token assign-left variable">ssl.truststore.location<span class="token operator">=/usr/local/kafka_2.12-2.8.0/ssl/client.truststore.jks
<span class="token assign-left variable">ssl.truststore.password<span class="token operator">=clearwater001<span class="token operator">!
</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
<h4><strong>7、配置kafka的server.properties配置文件，添加如下内容</strong></h4>
<pre class="language-bash"><code class="language-bash"><span class="token comment">#sasl_ssl
<span class="token assign-left variable">listeners<span class="token operator">=SASL_SSL://172.17.0.53:9093
<span class="token assign-left variable">advertised.listeners<span class="token operator">=SASL_SSL://172.17.0.53:9093
<span class="token assign-left variable">security.inter.broker.protocol<span class="token operator">=SASL_SSL
<span class="token assign-left variable">sasl.enabled.mechanisms<span class="token operator">=PLAIN
<span class="token assign-left variable">sasl.mechanism.inter.broker.protocol<span class="token operator">=PLAIN
<span class="token assign-left variable">authorizer.class.name<span class="token operator">=kafka.security.auth.SimpleAclAuthorizer
<span class="token assign-left variable">allow.everyone.if.no.acl.found<span class="token operator">=true
<span class="token assign-left variable">ssl.keystore.location<span class="token operator">=/usr/local/kafka_2.12-2.8.0/ssl/server.keystore.jks
<span class="token assign-left variable">ssl.keystore.password<span class="token operator">=clearwater001<span class="token operator">!
<span class="token assign-left variable">ssl.key.password<span class="token operator">=clearwater001<span class="token operator">!
<span class="token assign-left variable">ssl.truststore.location<span class="token operator">=/usr/local/kafka_2.12-2.8.0/ssl/server.truststore.jks
<span class="token assign-left variable">ssl.truststore.password<span class="token operator">=clearwater001<span class="token operator">!
<span class="token assign-left variable">ssl.endpoint.identification.algorithm<span class="token operator">=
</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
<h4><strong>8、重启zookeeper和kafka，创建topic（命令在第四节），添加生产者和消费者授权</strong></h4>
<pre class="language-bash"><code class="language-bash"><span class="token comment">#生产者授权
./kafka-acls.sh --authorizer-properties <span class="token assign-left variable">zookeeper.connect<span class="token operator">=localhost:2181 <span class="token parameter variable">--add --allow-principal User:<span class="token string">"kafka" <span class="token parameter variable">--producer <span class="token parameter variable">--topic <span class="token string">"test"
<span class="token comment">#消费者授权
./kafka-acls.sh --authorizer-properties <span class="token assign-left variable">zookeeper.connect<span class="token operator">=localhost:2181 <span class="token parameter variable">--add --allow-principal User:<span class="token string">"kafka" <span class="token parameter variable">--consumer <span class="token parameter variable">--topic <span class="token string">"test" <span class="token parameter variable">--group <span class="token string">'*'
</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
<h1><strong>四、相关启动命令</strong></h1>
<h4><strong>1、启动zookeeper</strong></h4>
<pre class="language-bash"><code class="language-bash">/usr/local/zookeeper/apache-zookeeper-3.5.9-bin/bin/zkServer.sh start 
</code></pre>
<h4><strong>2、启动kafka-server</strong></h4>
<pre class="language-bash"><code class="language-bash">./kafka-server-start.sh  <span class="token parameter variable">-daemon /usr/local/kafka_2.12-2.8.0/config/server.properties  
</span></code></pre>
<h4><strong>3、创建topic</strong></h4>
<pre class="language-bash"><code class="language-bash">./kafka-topics.sh <span class="token parameter variable">--create <span class="token parameter variable">--zookeeper localhost:2181 --replication-factor <span class="token number">1 <span class="token parameter variable">--partitions <span class="token number">1 <span class="token parameter variable">--topic <span class="token builtin class-name">test 
<span class="token comment">#查看topic list 
./kafka-topics.sh <span class="token parameter variable">--list <span class="token parameter variable">--zookeeper localhost:2181 
</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
<h4><strong>4、加密前生产消费消息（一般使用新版本命令）</strong></h4>
<pre class="language-bash"><code class="language-bash"><span class="token comment">###生产消息###
<span class="token comment">#老版本
./kafka-console-producer.sh --broker-list localhost:9092 <span class="token parameter variable">--topic <span class="token builtin class-name">test
<span class="token comment">#新版本
./kafka-console-producer.sh --bootstrap-server localhost:9092 <span class="token parameter variable">--topic <span class="token builtin class-name">test

<span class="token comment">###消费消息###
<span class="token comment">#老版本
./kafka-console-consumer.sh <span class="token parameter variable">--zookeeper localhost:2181 <span class="token parameter variable">--topic <span class="token builtin class-name">test --from-beginning
<span class="token comment">#新版本
./kafka-console-consumer.sh --bootstrap-server localhost:9092 <span class="token parameter variable">--topic <span class="token builtin class-name">test --from-beginning
</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
<h4><strong>5、加密后生产消费消息命令</strong></h4>
<pre class="language-bash"><code class="language-bash"><span class="token comment">#生产消息 
./kafka-console-producer.sh --bootstrap-server <span class="token number">172.17.0.53:9093 <span class="token parameter variable">--topic <span class="token builtin class-name">test <span class="token parameter variable">--producer.config client-ssl.properties 
<span class="token comment">#消费消息
./kafka-console-consumer.sh --bootstrap-server <span class="token number">172.17.0.53:9093 <span class="token parameter variable">--topic <span class="token builtin class-name">test --from-beginning <span class="token parameter variable">--consumer.config client-ssl.properties</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
